cards.name: Aggressive Mammoth

cards.name: Ajani's Pridemate

cards.name: Ancestor Dragon
cards.notes: Flying is a printed keyword. The life gain scales with the number of attacking creatures, and the schema's amount quantities (source_power, source_toughness, target_power, x) cannot express a count of permanents, so that effect is unmodeled. Also note the real trigger fires once for the whole attack, not once per creature, which the 'attacks' event does not distinguish.

abilities.reason: Conditional cost reduction; the schema cannot express cost modification.
abilities.text: This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a Wizard.

cards.name: Arcane Epiphany
cards.notes: The cost-reduction line is a static ability affecting the spell's cost; the schema has no cost-modification shape, so it is unmodeled. The draw is exact.

abilities.reason: No beginning-of-combat trigger event in the schema, and no way to mark the effect as optional.
abilities.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target creature get +2/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
cards.notes: The trigger is at the beginning of combat on your turn, which is not among the schema's trigger events, so the whole ability is unmodeled rather than approximated by a different timing. The 'may' optionality would also be unrepresentable.

cards.name: Bear Cub
cards.notes: Vanilla creature with no rules text.

cards.name: Beast-Kin Ranger
cards.notes: Trample is a printed keyword and is not emitted as an effect. The trigger's subject is restricted to other creatures you control.

cards.name: Bigfin Bouncer
cards.notes: "Return to its owner's hand" is modeled as move_to hand; the target is always opponent-controlled, so ownership and control coincide here in practice.

effects.reason: No schema support for distributing counters among a variable number of targets or for doubling existing counters.
effects.text: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on each of those creatures.

cards.name: Biogenic Upgrade
cards.notes: The schema's put_counters places a fixed count on one target spec; it cannot express distributing three counters among one, two, or three chosen creatures, nor the subsequent doubling of each creature's +1/+1 counters. Both clauses are left unmodeled rather than approximated as a fixed placement.

cards.name: Bishop's Soldier
cards.notes: Lifelink is a printed keyword ability and the parenthetical is reminder text, so no abilities are emitted.

cards.name: Bite Down

effects.reason: No way to express the intervening-if life-loss condition, and no way to express "each opponent" as distinct from a single opponent; emitting the discard alone would state a rule that is often false.
effects.text: if an opponent lost life this turn, each opponent discards a card

cards.name: Bloodtithe Collector
cards.notes: Flying is a printed keyword, not emitted. The intervening-if condition "if an opponent lost life this turn" has no representation in the schema, and the discard is meaningless without it, so the whole clause is left unmodeled rather than emitted as an unconditional discard.

abilities.reason: The trigger's "during an opponent's turn" timing restriction cannot be expressed on a triggered ability.

cards.name: Brineborn Cutthroat
cards.notes: Flash is a printed keyword and its parenthetical is reminder text. The trigger event you_cast_spell exists, but the schema cannot restrict it to an opponent's turn, so the whole triggered ability is left unmodeled rather than shown as triggering on every spell you cast.

effects.reason: A target spec cannot attach the has_flying condition to only one of several permitted kinds.

cards.name: Broken Wings
cards.notes: The target condition has_flying applies only to the creature option, not to artifacts or enchantments. A single target spec would either wrongly require flying on all three types or wrongly allow any creature, so the effect is unmodeled.

cards.name: Burrog Befuddler
cards.notes: Flash is a printed keyword and its reminder text is not an ability. -1/-0 is modeled as modify_stats with a negative power.

effects.reason: No schema support for riders conditioned on how produced mana is spent.

abilities.reason: No trigger event for drawing a card; the closest listed events (you_cast_spell, you_gain_life) would be a different rule.

cards.notes: Flying is a printed keyword, so no effect is emitted. The draw trigger has no matching trigger event in the schema (there is no "you draw a card" event), so the whole ability is unmodeled rather than approximated.

cards.name: Crossway Troublemakers
cards.notes: Both abilities are unmodeled. The first needs a static keyword grant restricted to attacking Vampires; there is no static ability kind for granting keywords, and no subtype condition. The second needs a subtype-restricted dies trigger plus an optional cost ("you may pay 2 life. If you do"), and the schema has no optional-cost or conditional construct.

abilities.reason: A triggered ability holds a single event, and there is no mill effect for moving the top N cards of your library to the graveyard.

cards.name: Crow of Dark Tidings

The remaining ability triggers on enters OR dies (one ability, two events, which the triggered shape cannot express) and mills, which has no effect kind; move_to with to_zone graveyard targets a specified permanent or card, not the top two cards of your library. Left unmodeled.

cards.name: Dazzling Angel
cards.notes: Flying is a printed keyword. The lifegain trigger maps exactly onto another_creature_enters with a subject restricted to creatures you control.

cards.name: Deadly Plot
cards.notes: Modal spell. The schema has no way to express "Choose one —", and emitting both modes as effects would say the spell does both, which is a wrong rule. Mode two also needs a subtype-restricted graveyard target and a return-to-battlefield-tapped effect. The whole spell body is unmodeled.

cards.name: Deadly Riposte

abilities.reason: No creature-subtype condition in affects specs, and no static ability kind that grants keywords.
abilities.text: Skeletons you control and other Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.

abilities.reason: Replacement effect applied as the permanent enters; the schema has no static or replacement shape for it.

cards.name: Diregraf Ghoul

Encoding it as triggered{enters} + set_tapped would misstate the timing (it would imply the creature enters untapped and is then tapped by a trigger that can be responded to), so it is left unmodeled. Confidence is medium only because that trigger-shaped approximation would give a beginner the right practical picture.

cards.name: Dragon Fodder

effects.reason: Spell abilities have no cost field, and there is no shape for an either/or additional cost.

cards.name: Skyship Buccaneer
cards.notes: Flying is a keyword. Raid is an intervening-if trigger: it only triggers if you attacked this turn, and the triggered shape has no condition field. Emitting a plain enters trigger that draws a card would teach the wrong rule, so the whole ability is unmodeled.

cards.name: Snakeskin Veil
cards.notes: The second sentence's "It" refers back to the same creature the counter was put on; the schema has no way to bind a later effect to an earlier effect's target, so the grant_keywords effect repeats the target spec "creature you control". A reader could wrongly think two different creatures may be chosen. Hexproof reminder text ignored.

cards.name: Spectral Sailor
cards.notes: Flash and flying are printed keyword abilities and are left to the keyword list. The activated ability has no tap or sacrifice component.

cards.name: Starlight Snare
cards.notes: "Enchant creature" is the Aura's attachment keyword, not emitted. Per the Aura convention, "enchanted creature" is {"kinds":["self"]}.

abilities.reason: Intervening-if condition on a trigger (Raid) cannot be expressed; the schema's triggered ability has no condition field.
abilities.text: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Storm Fleet Spy
cards.notes: Raid checks an intervening-if condition ("if you attacked this turn") both on trigger and on resolution. The schema's triggered shape has no condition field, and encoding it as an unconditional "draw a card" on enter would teach the wrong rule, so the whole ability is left unmodeled.

abilities.reason: Intervening-if condition is not expressible, and the target is restricted by creature type (Vampire), which target.conditions cannot state.
abilities.text: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target Vampire you control.

cards.name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
cards.notes: Two parts fail the schema: the intervening-if condition "if an opponent lost life this turn", and "target Vampire you control" (creature-type restrictions are not among target.conditions). Encoding it as an unconditional counter on any creature you control would be wrong on both counts.

abilities.reason: Cost "exile this card from your graveyard", activation from the graveyard zone, and the sorcery-speed timing restriction have no representation in the activated cost shape.
abilities.text: {4}{B}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Suspicious Shambler
cards.notes: The activated ability's cost includes exiling this card from the graveyard (and the ability is activated from the graveyard, with sorcery-speed timing). The cost shape supports only mana, tap, and sacrifice_self, so none of that survives encoding; the ability is left whole as unmodeled rather than shown as a plain {4}{B}{B} battlefield ability.

cards.name: Swab Goblin
cards.notes: Vanilla creature with no rules text.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.notes: The {T}: Add {B} line is printed as reminder text because the ability is intrinsic to the basic land type, but it is a real mana ability, so it is modeled explicitly for the mana solver.

cards.name: Tajuru Pathwarden
cards.notes: Vigilance and trample are printed keyword abilities with reminder text only; nothing else to model.

cards.name: Terror of Mount Velus
cards.notes: Flying and double strike are keyword abilities and are not emitted as effects. The enters trigger affects every creature you control and targets nothing; the schema only offers a target spec, so {"kinds":["creature"],"controller":"you"} here means the whole group, not one chosen creature.

cards.name: Thornweald Archer
cards.notes: Reach and deathtouch are keyword abilities already on the card's keyword list, so no abilities are emitted.

abilities.reason: Cost-reduction static abilities are not representable; no effect kind or static shape covers modifying a spell's own mana cost.
abilities.text: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.

cards.name: Tolarian Terror
cards.notes: The cost reduction is a static effect on casting cost, which the schema has no shape for, so it is unmodeled. Ward {2} is treated as a keyword ability already on the card's keyword list and is not emitted, but note the {2} amount is not captured anywhere in this object.

abilities.reason: Condition-gated static keyword grant; the schema has no static ability that grants keywords and no way to express the "25 or more life" condition.
abilities.text: As long as you have 25 or more life, this creature has double strike.

cards.name: Twinblade Paladin
cards.notes: The double strike ability is conditional on a life total (25 or more). There is no shape for a condition-gated static keyword grant, so that ability is unmodeled rather than approximated as an unconditional keyword. Reminder text ignored.

abilities.reason: Enters-tapped and the color choice are replacement effects, not triggered or static abilities in this schema.
abilities.text: This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color.

effects.reason: produce_mana requires a concrete color; the color here is chosen as the land enters and cannot be expressed.
effects.text: Add one mana of the chosen color.

cards.name: Uncharted Haven
cards.notes: The mana ability produces one mana of a color chosen as the land entered, and produce_mana has no way to express a chosen or variable color, so the effect is unmodeled. The mana solver will therefore not see this land as a mana source. Entering tapped and choosing a color are replacement effects with no schema shape.

effects.reason: Granting a triggered ability to a creature is not representable; no effect kind grants abilities, only keywords.
effects.text: Until end of turn, target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it."

cards.name: Undying Malice
cards.notes: The spell grants a creature a temporary triggered ability. Effects cannot nest an ability grant, and grant_keywords only takes keywords, so the whole effect is unmodeled.

abilities.reason: No static ability shape grants keywords continuously; menace is also not a schema-listed keyword condition.
abilities.text: Enchanted creature has menace.

cards.name: Untamed Hunger
cards.notes: The +2/+1 is a static_modifier on what the Aura is attached to. The menace grant is split out as unmodeled: static_modifier carries only power/toughness, and grant_keywords is an effect (something an ability does), not a continuous static ability. Reminder text ignored.

cards.name: Vampire Interloper
cards.notes: Flying is a printed keyword and is not emitted.

cards.name: Vampire Neonate
cards.notes: "Each opponent loses 1 life" is modeled as change_life with who "opponent"; in a multiplayer game this applies to every opponent, which the single who value does not distinguish.

cards.name: Vampire Spawn
cards.notes: "Each opponent loses 2 life" is modeled as change_life with who "opponent"; in a multiplayer game this applies to every opponent, which the single who value does not distinguish.

cards.name: Vengeful Bloodwitch
cards.notes: "This creature or another creature you control" is captured as subject = any creature you control, which is exactly the same set. "Target opponent loses 1 life" is modeled as change_life with who "opponent"; the fact that the opponent is chosen as a target is not representable, which matters only in multiplayer.

effects.reason: Damage amount is a count of permanents you control; the amount schema cannot express a board count.
effects.text: it deals damage to target creature an opponent controls equal to the number of Goblins you control

cards.name: Volley Veteran
cards.notes: The trigger is modeled, but the damage amount counts Goblins you control. The amount schema allows only an integer or source_power/source_toughness/target_power/x, none of which is a board count, so the whole damage clause is unmodeled rather than guessed at a fixed number.

cards.name: Wildheart Invoker
cards.notes: Activated ability with a pure mana cost of {8} and no tap. Both effects target the same creature (any controller) and last until end of turn. The parenthetical is reminder text for trample and is not modeled.

abilities.reason: Static replacement effect that applies as the permanent enters; the schema has no replacement-effect shape, and modeling it as an enters trigger would misrepresent the timing.
abilities.text: This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.

abilities.reason: No trigger event exists for counters being put on a permanent, and the schema cannot express the non-Hydra subtype exclusion.
abilities.text: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Wildwood Scourge
cards.notes: Both abilities are left unmodeled. "Enters with X +1/+1 counters" is a replacement effect, not an enters trigger, and the counters are already there as it enters; encoding it as triggered/put_counters would misstate the timing (and X is a cast-time choice, not a resolving amount here). The second ability triggers on counters being placed on another non-Hydra creature you control, an event the schema's trigger list does not contain.
